authority: Exploratory supplement only; the official analysis, criteria, statistics, and classification are unchanged.

diagnosis.summary: The official exploratory clock-onset predicate is evaluated over all trace rows, but decoded arbiter values are available only for plateau rows. Rows outside the plateau therefore receive the default fmax value and cannot satisfy the official clock-onset predicate.
diagnosis.classification_impact: none; onset is exploratory and does not enter R/K/P criteria or the H-DS classification

source_refs.finding: The clock onset iterates all rows but uses decoded_by_id.get(id(row), {}).get("arb", {}).get("aiclk_arb_max_frequency_mhz", spec.asic_fmax).
decoded_by_id is populated by iterating plateau_rows only.
_decode_plateau_values receives plateau_rows, while _exploratory receives the full rows sequence and the plateau-only decoded_by_id mapping.

official_predicate_reused.glitch_exclusion: none for this raw-trace supplement; candidate zero-word, official-glitch, and ambiguity status are reported explicitly
